notes: Weights operate on min-max normalized metrics (0-1) across the candidate set actually available for a category. costEfficiency = 1 / blendedPrice1m, where blendedPrice1m assumes a 3:1 output:input token ratio (typical agentic coding workload) -- a documented simplification since Copilot (plan + credits) and OpenCode Go (flat $10/mo with per-model monthly caps) aren't priced the same way; per-token blended price is the common denominator we have. speed = performance.median_output_tokens_per_second from Artificial Analysis. topN is the overall (cross-provider) shortlist size; topNPerProvider is the shortlist size within each individual provider.

agenticCoding.description: Left running for hours in a loop to solve a problem autonomously with minimal supervision (e.g. an OpenSpec/plan executor, a long-running coding agent).

codeReview.description: Reviewing code written by a different model, reasoning about correctness/design in context rather than driving tools itself.

softwareFactory.description: Executing well-scoped, already-planned coding tasks (e.g. from an OpenSpec change or a larger model's plan) -- throughput and cost matter more than raw intelligence.
